描述_EN: after the 1970s the popularity of this toy diminished until the 1990s when toy manufacturers started taking an interest again and made up to date versions like this example. jack-in-the boxes were originally known as 'punch boxes' as they were often rather frightening. the springing figure tended to be a clown but by the 1970s the clown was being replaced by new figures such as noddy. curious george is a popular children's book character in the united states. they were also basic educational toys teaching simple scientific principles in an interesting way.
描述_ZN: 20世纪70年代后，这种玩具的受欢迎程度有所下降，直到20世纪90年代，玩具制造商开始重新关注并制造出像这个例子一样的最新版本。 Jack-in-the boxes最初被称为 "打孔箱"，因为它们通常相当吓人。 蹦蹦跳跳的人物往往是一个小丑，但是到了1970年代，小丑被新的人物如Noddy所取代。 好奇的乔治是美国的一个流行的儿童书籍角色。 它们也是基本的教育玩具，以一种有趣的方式教授简单的科学原理。
